name: Tavian Briarhand
source_profile: ● Tavian Briarhand (CN), is a young Velthari warband captain. Charismatic, daring, and fiercely opposed to further concessions. Tavian leads bands of young warriors who sabotage logging camps, destroy survey markers, and occasionally attack timber caravans. His growing popularity threatens Elaris's authority.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 65 (source excerpt; may be partial)
